lines: The Baltimore Orioles beat the Boston Red Sox 5-1 in yesterday’s doubleheader Game 2.
The Indiana Fever beat the Connecticut Sun, improving to 17‑10 and staying atop the Eastern Conference.
The Indianapolis Indians edged the Lehigh Valley IronPigs 2-1 yesterday and will host a rematch tonight at 7:05 PM ET.
Indy Eleven host Loudoun United FC at 7:00 PM ET on Saturday.
The St. Louis Cardinals take on the Arizona Diamondbacks today at 5:15 PM ET in a makeup game from June 25.
